name: workshop-frontend
//optionalDependencies: ~84 MB installed and ~3.4 MB of lazy chunks in a build, for a feature an
installation may never use, so it is optional rather than required: it is
installed by default and `npm install --omit=optional` leaves it out. Every
other command still works without it — a fence then renders as the code block
it was before diagrams existed. See the optional-dependency section of
vite.config.ts for how the import survives the package being absent.
CAVEAT, node 18: npm SKIPS an optional dependency whose engines do not match,
silently and with no way to override (--force and --engine-strict are both
ignored). mermaid needs marked@16, which declares node >= 20, so a CLEAN
install under node 18 gets no diagrams no matter what it asks for. An install
under node >= 20 gets them, and a later node-18 `npm install` keeps what is
already there rather than pruning it. If diagrams disappear after an install,
that is what happened: re-run the install once under node >= 20.
